title: A website guest booking is confirmed by the guest's own email before it holds a slot or records marketing consent

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), website cluster review of #3289 (LIVE-835).

detail: FILED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: createGuestBookingAction creates a CONFIRMED booking for any typed name and email, limited only by a honeypot and six bookings per IP per ten minutes, sends the confirmation to that address and records captureLead(..., optedIn) for an address the visitor may not own. A bot rotating IPs can hold every open slot and send platform mail to third parties. THE FIX (owner ruling): hold guest bookings pending until an emailed confirm link is clicked, or cap guest bookings per Space per day; record optedIn only after confirmation.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';if(!/guestConfirm|confirmGuestBooking/.test(r('lib/spaces/booking-actions.ts'))){console.error('SCAN-834: a website guest booking confirms and records consent without proof of the email');process.exit(1)}"
